title: 第4章  周皇的执行力，又赐婚了！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
从御书房出来，赵辰安的心情前所未有的舒畅。
天高云淡，暖阳拂面。
他成功了。
用一个无法被证伪的弥天大谎，将自己和父皇赵道霆这位大周王朝最有权势的男人，彻底绑在了一起。
《大道天衍经》是真的。
那份直指圣人境界的诱惑，足以让任何帝王疯狂。
而自己，就是那个唯一能开启宝藏的钥匙。
从今往后，他不再是那个只能混吃等死的废柴皇子，而是大周王朝走向皇朝甚至天朝的唯一希望！
这感觉，不赖。
回到十六皇子府。
府邸门口，一道纤柔的白色身影正踮着脚尖，焦急地来回踱步，不时朝着宫城的方向张望。
是乌兰雪。
她身上还穿着那件繁复的妃袍，显然从大婚后就没换过。
纯白的长裙衬着她雪白的肌肤，在阳光下美得有些不真实。
看到赵辰安的身影出现在街角，她那双清澈的眸子瞬间亮了起来。
所有的不安与焦急都化作了满溢的欣喜。
她提起裙摆，小跑着迎了上来。
“夫君！”
看着自己刚过门的小娇妻这般粘人，赵辰安微微一愣，随即心中涌起一股暖流。
这就是家的感觉吗？

他快步上前，一把拉住乌兰雪微凉的小手，顺势将她揽入怀中。
“跑出来做什么，风这么大。”
他故意板起脸。
“下次老老实实在床上等我便是。”
怀中的娇躯猛地一僵。
乌兰雪的脸颊“腾”地一下就红透了，一直蔓延到白皙的脖颈。
昨夜床榻之上，那令人面红耳赤的疯狂与索取，瞬间涌上心头。
她把脸埋在赵辰安的胸口，不敢抬头，细若蚊蝇地“嗯”了一声。
赵辰安轻笑，牵着她的手，大步向府内走去。
两人刚踏入前厅，一名下人就匆匆跑来。
“殿下，三皇子殿下来了，正在厅里等您。”
话音刚落，一个爽朗的笑声就从厅内传了出来。
“十六弟，你可算回来了！再不回来，你这府里的茶都要被我喝光了！”
只见一个身穿蟒袍，面容俊朗的青年大步流星地走了出来。
正是三皇子，赵辰宇。
赵辰安的脑中瞬间闪过关于这位三哥的信息。
生母是贵妃，在宫中颇有势力。
本人也开辟了苦海，算得上是年轻一辈中的佼佼者。
最关键的是，这桩与天狼部落的婚事，本该是他的。
是他，在父皇面前哭天抢地，说自己心有所属，非李大将军之女李青鸾不娶。

又说什么草原女子粗鄙不堪，配不上皇室血脉，这才让父皇把这桩婚事推给了自己这个“废人”。
现在又这般亲近，来干嘛的？
莫不是得了便宜还卖乖？
赵辰安念头飞转，面上却不动声色，挂上了符合原身人设的憨厚笑容。
“三哥！你怎么有空来了？”
赵辰宇的视线在赵辰安和乌兰雪紧握的双手上扫过。
而后落在了乌兰雪那张足以令任何男人失神的绝美容颜上。
他眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的惊艳，但很快便被一抹庆幸所取代。
再美又如何？
终究是个蛮夷女子，血脉不纯，怎比得上京城第一美人，将门虎女李青鸾？
“弟妹也在啊。”
赵辰宇装作才看到乌兰雪的样子，笑着从自己的储物法器中取出一物。
那是一柄通体碧绿的短剑，剑鞘上镶嵌着宝石，灵气流转，赫然是一把下品法剑。
“听闻弟妹是草原上的天狼圣女，自幼便精通武艺。”
“这柄‘碧水剑’，削铁如泥，就当是三哥我补给你的新婚贺礼了。”
赵辰安故作惊讶地眨了眨眼。
“贺礼？三哥，昨日大婚你不是已经送过了吗？”
赵辰宇哈哈一笑，拍了拍赵辰安的肩膀。
“那份是给你的，这份是给弟妹的，不一样。”
演的还挺像。

赵辰安心中冷笑，脸上却是一副恍然大悟的模样。
这哪里是送礼，分明是这位三哥良心不安，来安慰自己这个替他顶了雷的倒霉蛋弟弟的。
他侧过身，对着乌兰雪笑道：
“还不快谢谢三哥？这可是好东西。”
乌兰雪有些不知所措，但还是乖巧地从赵辰宇手中接过了法剑，轻声道谢。
“多谢三哥。”
赵辰安顺势搂住乌兰雪的腰，对着赵辰宇挤眉弄眼地打趣道：
“三哥你太有心了！不过说真的，这桩婚事，小弟可是喜欢的很呐！”
他说的情真意切，没有半分虚假。
一旁，乌兰雪听到这话，心尖猛地一颤。
她抬起头，怔怔地看着赵辰安的侧脸。
自己的夫君，当着他哥哥的面，说喜欢这桩婚事，喜欢自己……
一股难以言喻的甜蜜与感动，瞬间填满了她的心房。
原来，他不是被迫的。
原来，他也是喜欢自己的。
她的小手，下意识地抓紧了赵辰安的衣袖。
脸上的红晕更胜，整个人都快要融化在男人怀里。
赵辰宇看着眼前这一幕，也是彻底放下了心。
看来这老十六是真没心没肺，娶个蛮女都乐呵呵的，倒也省了自己一番口舌。
他摆了摆手，准备告辞。

“行了行了，看你们俩这腻歪劲，我这做哥哥的也就不打扰你们了。改日再……”
他的话还没说完，一道尖细却极具穿透力的声音，骤然从府外传来！
“圣旨到！”
三个字，让整个皇子府前厅的空气，瞬间凝固。
所有人都是一滞。
只见一名身穿暗红色宦官服，头发花白，面容阴柔的老太监。
在一队禁军的簇拥下，手捧一卷明黄色的圣旨，缓缓走了进来。
来人，正是父皇身边最信任的大太监，魏公公！
赵辰宇脸上的轻松笑容僵住了。
乌兰雪也紧张地抓紧了赵辰安。
赵辰安心中咯噔一下。
这才刚从宫里出来，又来一道圣旨？父皇这是要干嘛？
魏公公走入厅内，那双浑浊的眼睛环视一圈，最终定格在赵辰安的身上。
他没有多余的废话，直接展开了圣旨。
“奉天承运，皇帝诏曰！”
冰冷肃穆的声音，回荡在厅堂之内。
赵辰安、赵辰宇、乌兰雪，连同府内所有下人，齐刷刷跪了一地。
“兹有车骑大将军李擎苍之女李青鸾，德才兼备，性情贤淑，与十六皇子赵辰安堪称良配。”
“为彰天恩，特将其赐予十六皇子为侧妃！”
“择吉日，七日后完婚！”

“钦此！”
content_en:
Coming out of the Imperial Study Room, Zhao Chenan felt more comfortable than ever before.
The sky is high and the clouds are light, and the warm sun is blowing on my face.
He succeeded.
He used a big lie that could not be falsified to completely tie himself to his father Zhao Daoting, the most powerful man in the Zhou Dynasty.
The "Dao Tian Yan Jing" is true.
The temptation that points directly to the realm of a saint is enough to drive any emperor crazy.
And you are the only key that can unlock the treasure.
From now on, he is no longer the good-for-nothing prince who can only live and die, but is the only hope for the Zhou Dynasty to move towards the imperial dynasty and even the celestial dynasty!
This feeling is not bad.
Return to the Sixteenth Prince's Mansion.
At the door of the mansion, a slender white figure was standing on tiptoes, pacing back and forth anxiously, looking in the direction of Miyagi from time to time.
It's Wu Lanxue.
She was still wearing the complicated concubine's robe, which had obviously not been changed since her wedding.
The pure white dress lined her snow-white skin, making her look unrealistically beautiful under the sun.
Seeing Zhao Chenan's figure appear at the street corner, her clear eyes lit up instantly.
All the uneasiness and anxiety turned into overflowing joy.
She lifted up her skirt and trotted towards him.
"Husband!"
Zhao Chenan was slightly startled when he saw how clingy his little wife who had just passed the door was, and then a warm current surged in his heart.
Is this what home feels like?
He quickly stepped forward, took Wu Lanxue's cold little hand, and took her into his arms.
"What are you doing out here? The wind is so strong."
He deliberately kept a straight face.
"Next time, just wait for me on the bed."
The delicate body in her arms suddenly stiffened.
Wu Lanxue's cheeks suddenly turned red, spreading all the way to her fair neck.
On the bed last night, the blushing madness and demands suddenly surged into my heart.
She buried her face in Zhao Chenan's chest, not daring to raise her head, and said "hmm" as thinly as a mosquito.
Zhao Chenan chuckled, held her hand, and strode towards the house.
As soon as the two stepped into the front hall, a servant hurried over.
"Your Highness, the Third Prince is here and is waiting for you in the hall."
As soon as he finished speaking, a hearty laughter came from the hall.
"Sixteenth Brother, you are back! If you don't come back, I will drink up all the tea in your house!"
I saw a young man wearing a python robe and a handsome face striding out.
It was the third prince, Zhao Chenyu.
Information about this third brother flashed through Zhao Chenan's mind.
The biological mother is a noble concubine and quite powerful in the palace.
I have also opened up a sea of ​​hardships and can be regarded as a leader among the younger generation.
The most important thing is that this marriage to the Sirius tribe should have been his.
It was he who cried and cried in front of his father, saying that his heart belonged to someone else and he would not marry Li Qingluan, the daughter of General Li.
He also said that prairie women were vulgar and unworthy of the royal bloodline, so his father pushed the marriage to him, a "waste".
Now that we are so close, what are you doing here?
Could it be that he acted well after getting a bargain?
Zhao Chenan's thoughts were racing, but his face remained calm, with a simple and honest smile that fit his original personality.
"Third brother! Why are you here free?"
Zhao Chenyu's eyes swept over the clasped hands of Zhao Chenan and Wu Lanxue.
Then it fell on Wu Lanxue's beautiful face that could make any man lose his mind.
There was a hint of imperceptible surprise in his eyes, but it was quickly replaced by a touch of happiness.
So what if it’s beautiful?
After all, she is a barbarian woman with impure blood. How can she compare to the most beautiful woman in the capital, Li Qingluan?
"My brothers and sisters are here too."
Zhao Chenyu pretended to have just seen Wu Lanxue, and took out something from his storage magic weapon with a smile.
It was a dagger that was completely green in color. The scabbard was inlaid with gems. The spiritual energy was flowing around it. It was clearly a low-grade magic sword.
"I heard that my sister-in-law is the Heavenly Wolf Saint on the grassland. She has been proficient in martial arts since she was a child."
"ThisThe 'Blue Water Sword' can cut iron like clay. Think of it as a wedding gift from me, Third Brother, to you. "
Zhao Chenan pretended to be surprised and blinked.
"Congratulations? Third brother, didn’t you already send me off for yesterday’s wedding? "
Zhao Chenyu laughed and patted Zhao Chenan on the shoulder.
“That one is for you, and this one is for your siblings, it’s different. "
The acting looks quite similar.
Zhao Chenan sneered in his heart, but his face looked like he suddenly realized something.
This is not a gift, it is clearly the third brother's conscience, coming to comfort his unlucky younger brother who took the blame for him.
He turned sideways and smiled at Wu Lanxue:
"Why don't you thank Third Brother quickly? This is good stuff. "
Wu Lanxue was a little at a loss, but she still obediently took the magic sword from Zhao Chenyu's hand and thanked him softly.
"Thank you, third brother. "
Zhao Chenan hugged Wu Lanxue's waist and winked at Zhao Chenyu and joked:
"Third brother, you are so thoughtful! But to be honest, my little brother really likes this marriage! "
What he said was true and sincere, without even a hint of falsehood.
Beside, Wu Lanxue's heart trembled when she heard this.
She raised her head and stared blankly at Zhao Chenan's side face.
My husband, in front of his brother, said that he liked this marriage and liked himself...
An indescribable sweetness and touching feeling instantly filled her heart.
It turned out that he was not forced.
It turns out that he also likes himself.
Her little hands subconsciously grasped Zhao Chenan's sleeves.
The blush on her face became even worse, and her whole body was about to melt into the man's arms.
Looking at the scene in front of him, Zhao Chenyu was completely relieved.
It seems that this old man is really heartless. He is happy to marry a barbarian girl, which saves him a lot of trouble.
He waved his hand and prepared to leave.
"Okay, okay, seeing how you two are acting like crazy, I, as the older brother, won't bother you anymore. See you another day..."
Before he finished speaking, a thin but penetrating voice suddenly came from outside the house!
"The decree has arrived! "
These three words made the air in the entire front hall of the Prince's Mansion freeze instantly.
Everyone is at a standstill.
I saw an old eunuch wearing a dark red eunuch's uniform, with gray hair and a feminine face.
Surrounded by a group of forbidden soldiers, they walked in slowly holding a bright yellow imperial edict in their hands.
The person who came was none other than Father Wei’s most trusted eunuch, Eunuch Wei!
The relaxed smile on Zhao Chenyu's face froze.
Wu Lanxue also tightened her grip on Zhao Chenan nervously.
Zhao Chenan's heart skipped a beat.
I just came out of the palace and there is another imperial edict? What is your father doing?
Eunuch Wei walked into the hall and looked around with his cloudy eyes, finally settling on Zhao Chenan.
Without any unnecessary nonsense, he directly unfolded the imperial edict.
"Blessed by heaven, the emperor decreed! "
The cold and solemn voice echoed in the hall.
Zhao Chenan, Zhao Chenyu, Wu Lanxue, and all the servants in the mansion knelt on the ground.
"I have Li Qingluan, the daughter of the great chariot general Li Qingcang. She has both political integrity and talent, and a virtuous temperament. She is a good match for the sixteenth prince Zhao Chenan. "
"To express Tian's grace, I specially give it to the sixteenth prince as his concubine! "
“Choose an auspicious day and get married in seven days! "
"Appreciate this! "
